svg.title: Noctiluca architecture
svg.desc: Browser-only architecture. main.tsx mounts App.tsx, which switches between MapScreen and PlayScreen, reads levels from questions, episodes and puzzles, stores progress in localStorage and calls python.ts, which drives a Web Worker running Pyodide from jsDelivr. A service worker caches the shell and runtime. Hosted on GitHub Pages.
svg.text: A static shell, a worker and a runtime.
